classes.name: Vanguard
classes.description: A frontline fighter forged through discipline and raw physical power, wielding heavy weapons in Ignareth's name.

classes.name: Arcanist
classes.description: A destructive spellcaster channeling elemental and arcane forces through relentless study of the old arcane traditions.

classes.name: Shade
classes.description: A stealth-driven striker built on deception, mobility, and precision, walking the paths favored by Nyxara.

classes.name: Warden
classes.description: A shapeshifting nature-caster balancing restoration and primal power under Aeloria's watch.

classes.name: Oathkeeper
classes.description: A sacred warrior bound by protective magic and divine vows, defending allies in Solthar's name.

classes.name: Wayfarer
classes.description: A ranged specialist built for exploration and survival, trained in traditions tied to Aeloria and the wandering orders beyond her reach.
